exposure: soluble platelet and endothelial cell adhesion molecule 1 (sPECAM-1)
cohort: The study included 73 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with early or late-onset FGR and 73 matched normal control pregnancies.
finding: Three new first trimester biomarkers (sNRP-1, sPECAM-1, and PDGF-AB/BB) are predictive of the subsequent development of early-onset FGR.
